newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch arrest British drug gang suspects.
newsitem.headline: Dutch arrest British drug gang suspects.

text.p: Dutch police arrested 11 people on Thursday suspected of belonging to a British-led gang which had been smuggling drugs from South America to Europe, a spokewsoman for the Hague public prosecutor's office said.

Nine Britons, including the suspected gang leader, a Colombian and a Russian were arrested at various locations in the Netherlands. Cocaine, heroin, hashish and ecstasy were seized as well as firearms, hand grenades and 800,000 guilders ($468,400) in cash.
The spokeswoman said Dutch police were assisted by British colleagues in their investigation of the case. ($1=1.708 Guilder)
